runs.text:
Floor Jansen is one of the most versatile and commanding voices in modern rock and metal. From her early breakthrough with After Forever to the world stages of Nightwish and her own solo work, she has built a career defined by power, range and emotional depth.

With her new single ‘RUN’ and the announcement of the HYTRESS Tour 2027, Jansen opens a heavier and more direct chapter in her solo path. Returning to international club stages with a full live band, she brings together the intensity of her metal roots, the melodic clarity of her solo work and the unmistakable vocal presence that has made her a defining voice across genres.
